title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!

author: GoldenProsper Games
title: Hiring 3D Character Artist (Anime Style, Freelance/Contract)
content: GoldenProsper Games is hiring: 3D Character Artist (Anime Style, Freelance/Contract). About us: GoldenProsper Games is an independent game studio from Indonesia building a stylized anime game. Our character designs and art direction are locked, and we are looking for a 3D character artist to bring them to life. The role: You will turn our finished character sheets into game-ready 3D models that match our illustrated art direction. Compensation: Rp3,300,000 – 4,000,000 (about USD 185–225) per character, fixed price, paid per milestone. How to apply: Fill in the form. Deadline: 30 october. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
